message.content:
This image shows the cover of "TEMPO" magazine, edition July 1-7, 2013. The main visual is an aerial photograph of a landscape partially obscured by thick white and gray smoke. Patches of green vegetation and charred, dark soil are visible through the haze. Some straight, lighter-colored paths or dirt clearings cut through the darker terrain. The landscape appears to be a forest or plantation area undergoing burning.

The large, red title "TEMPO" is positioned at the top. Above it, in gray capital letters, is the phrase "MAKELAR PANGKAT DI MARKAS POLISI." In the center, the bold white text "ASAP INC." is prominently displayed. Below this, smaller white text reads: "TAK CUMA DILAKUKAN WARGA KAMPUNG, PEMBAKARAN HUTAN MELIBATKAN KORPORASI KAKAP." 

In the bottom right corner, a barcode, the price "RP 33.000", the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "ISSN: 0126-4273" are visible. A red border runs down the left edge and along the bottom of the cover. No people or animals are clearly discernible.
